# openwebui_suggestions_config (Resource)

Manages default prompt suggestions shown in Open WebUI.

~> **Note:** The suggestions API does not expose a read endpoint. Terraform preserves state from the last apply and cannot detect out-of-band changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_suggestions_config" "example" {
  suggestions = [
    {
      title   = ["Explain this", "in simple terms"]
      content = "Explain the following concept in simple terms that a non-expert could understand:"
    },
    {
      title   = ["Summarize"]
      content = "Summarize the following in 3 bullet points:"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `suggestions` (Attributes List) List of default prompt suggestions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--suggestions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Set by Open WebUI.

<a id="nestedatt--suggestions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `suggestions`

Required:

- `content` (String) Full prompt text sent when the user selects this suggestion.
- `title` (List of String) Display title lines for the suggestion (list of strings).
